# Whisper spelling data

`english.json` is vendored unchanged from OpenAI Whisper:
https://github.com/openai/whisper/blob/86098128c0b4f24f0e2aa2994de830614b474227/whisper/normalizers/english.json

Fetched from commit `86098128c0b4f24f0e2aa2994de830614b474227`.
